record.label: Probability-one recovery of a marked index
record.statement: Find-Any terminates with probability one and outputs an index $x\in S$.
record.boundary: For $n=3$, $m=k=2$, and $S=\{1,6\}$, either $1$ or $6$ satisfies the postcondition. The theorem applies at this size and at sizes for which the circuit uses the weakly measured loop.
